item.text: The spatial goals require rearranging the finite store witnesses, then adding the terminal empty heap. I’ll use pointwise witness transformations with the permitted join lemmas.

arguments.code:
var helpers = `
Lemma cand_id (P : Assertion) : P |-- P.
Proof. intros h H; exact H. Qed.
Lemma cand_trans (P Q R : Assertion) : (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros H K h HP; apply K, H, HP. Qed.
Lemma cand_comm (P Q : Assertion) : P ** Q |-- Q ** P.
Proof.
  intros h (a & b & H). destruct H as [J [HP HQ]].
  exists b, a. split; [apply join_comm; exact J | split; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma cand_assoc (P Q R : Assertion) : (P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R).
Proof.
  intros h (ab & c & J & (a & b & K & HP & HQ) & HR).
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J) as (bc & L & M).
  exists a, bc. split; [exact M | split; [exact HP |]].
  exists b, c. split; [exact L | split; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma cand_frame (P Q R S : Assertion) : (P |-- R) -> (Q |-- S) -> P ** Q |-- R ** S.
Proof.
  intros F G h (a & b & J & HP & HQ).
  exists a, b. split; [exact J | split; [apply F | apply G]; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma cand_lift (A B T R : Assertion) : (B |-- T ** R) -> A ** B |-- T ** (A ** R).
Proof.
  intros F h (a & b & J & HA & HB).
  destruct (F _ HB) as (t & r & K & HT & HR).
  pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ J) as J'.
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J') as (ra & L & M).
  exists t, ra. split; [exact M | split; [exact HT |]].
  exists a, r. split; [apply join_comm; exact L | split; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma cand_unit (P : Assertion) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros h H. destruct (unit_join h) as (u & U & J).
  exists h, u. split; [exact J | split; assumption].
Qed.
Ltac cand_extract :=
  first [apply cand_id | apply cand_comm |
    eapply cand_lift; cand_extract].
Ltac cand_arrange :=
  first [apply cand_id |
    lazymatch goal with
    | |- ((?A ** ?B) ** ?C) |-- ?D =>
      eapply cand_trans; [apply cand_assoc | cand_arrange]
    | |- (?A ** ?B) |-- (?A ** ?C) =>
      apply cand_frame; [apply cand_id | cand_arrange]
    | |- ?A |-- (?T ** ?R) =>
      first [eapply cand_trans; [apply cand_unit | apply cand_frame; [apply cand_id | intros h H; repeat split; try reflexivity; exact H]] |
        eapply cand_trans with (Q := T ** _);
        [cand_extract | apply cand_frame; [apply cand_id | cand_arrange]]]
    end].
Ltac cand_normalize :=
  cbn [CharArray.full CharArray.undef_full store_array store_undef_array
       store_array_rec store_undef_array_rec repeat_Z
       StoreCharAsElement.storeA StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA];
  repeat rewrite sizeof_char;
  cbn [Z.add Z.mul Z.to_nat Pos.to_nat];
  cand_arrange.

`; candidate = candidate.replace('\n\nTheorem', '\n'+helpers+'Theorem');
var idx=0; candidate=candidate.replace(/Proof\. Admitted\./g,()=>{idx++; if(idx<=16){var n=Math.ceil(idx/2); return idx%2 ? 'Proof. unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_'+n+'_split_goal_spatial. cand_normalize. Qed.' : 'Proof. unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_'+n+'. right. exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_'+n+'_split_goal_spatial. Qed.';} if(idx===17)return 'Proof. unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_1. intros h H. change (repeat_Z 0 0 = @nil Z). reflexivity. Qed.'; if(idx===18)return 'Proof. unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_spatial. cand_normalize. Qed.'; if(idx===19)return 'Proof. unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_9. right. intros h H. split. - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_1 h H). - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_spatial h H). Qed.'; return 'Proof. unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_return_wit_1. right. intros; subst. intros h H. exists (repeat_Z 0 8). revert h H. cand_normalize. Qed.';}); await fs.writeFile('Candidate.v',candidate); nodeRepl.write('Updated Candidate.v');
